title: Selling Plans — Order-Size Caps on Refund Administration Fees
content:
The refund administration fee withheld from a **Selling Plans** refund credit is held to a cap that rises with the size of the refunded order, measured by the fee basis on its variable final value fee record.

**Rule.** The refund administration fee cap is the large-order refund cap when the order's fee basis is at least the large-order basis, the mid-order refund cap when it is at least the mid-order basis but below the large-order basis, and the refund administration fee cap below the mid-order basis.

| Fee basis of the refunded order | Refund administration fee cap |
|---|---|
| USD 1000.00 or more (the large-order basis) | USD 10.00 (large-order refund cap) |
| USD 250.00 or more but below USD 1000.00 (the mid-order basis up to the large) | USD 7.50 (mid-order refund cap) |
| Below USD 250.00 | The plan's refund administration fee cap |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical orders)

- Fee basis USD 1000.00 → USD 10.00; USD 999.99 → USD 7.50.
- Fee basis USD 250.00 → USD 7.50; USD 249.99 → the plan's refund administration fee cap.

**Holding to the cap (hypothetical).** A fee worked out at USD 9.00 on an order with a fee basis of USD 600.00 is held to USD 7.50; on an order with a fee basis of USD 1600.00 it stays at USD 9.00.
